title: ISO IEC 25012 Data Quality Model
summary: ISO/IEC 25012 — defines a general data quality model for data retained in a structured format within a computer system, with inherent and system-dependent characteristics.
body_markdown:
# ISO IEC 25012 Data Quality Model

## Scope

A data quality model (part of the SQuaRE family) categorising quality characteristics as inherent, system-dependent, or both.

## Requirements

Defines characteristics (e.g. accuracy, completeness, consistency, credibility, currentness, and others). The full list must be taken from the standard.

## Applicability

Defining [[Data Quality Dimension|quality dimensions]] and requirements in a standards-aligned way.

## Related Architecture Concepts

[[Data Quality]], [[Data Quality Dimension]].

## Related Controls

None yet.

## Verification Notes

Edition year and characteristic list to be verified.
